title: ye ghame shabbir hai dunya ko bataate chalo
body:
ye ghame shabbir hai dunya ko bataate chalo
<<MINI>>
karke baya'n zikre gham sabko rulaate chalo
<<DIVIDER>>
is ghame shabbir ko kaise bhulaaenge ham
hashr tak ahle jahan isko sunaaenge ham
daagh jo matam ke hai sab ko dikhaaenge ham

ahle aza aapko deti hai zahra dua

kitna alamnaak hai maarekaye karbala

sirf bahattar the wo laakh thi fouje sitam
